title: *CS601 GDB Answer Idea by VU Mentor*
text:
*CS601 GDB Answer Idea by VU Mentor*


*Your choice: Latency*
*Reason 1:* The problem is the delay between a player's action and the response on screen, which is latency itself, while bandwidth is already sufficient, so adding more capacity would not fix it.
*Reason 2:* In real-time multiplayer gaming, responsiveness matters more than raw data rate, so lowering latency through closer servers and better routing directly improves gameplay and user experience.
Note: the GDB says no grace day, and posts can't be edited once submitted — so it's worth posting this today, before the closing time.



> VU Mentor
